news.text: #Juve, Last Call For #KoopAgainst #SassuoloWithout #Locatelli, the Dutchman will be a regista next to #DouglasLuiz.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

SHOCK THERAPY FOR #DOUGLASBehind the scenes: here is how #Spalletti shook up the Brazilian 'restoring' him to #Juve.The ex #AstonVilla seemed lost to the bianconero cause: in Liège, the manager gave him a harsh talk: "If you follow me and raise your level, you will become the player you used to be, otherwise...". From that point came the turning point. Meanwhile, #Koop, #McKennie, #Woltemade, #Sarr and the youngster #Owusu are warming up for #Sassuolo.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🆙✍️ "#Juventus wants to further lock down #Kalulu and #Conceição in the coming weeks. When the club begins planning for the January mercato window, they will need, above all, to have a very clear picture of which contracts they will manage to renew and which, instead, will prove more complicated to extend. This is why I expect news soon."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "#Juventus tried to sign Darryl #Bakola at the end of August but failed to finalize the deal.However, the club has set sights on him for the future and it is highly likely they will attempt again in the January mercato window.The Frenchman was the last signing made by the director Giovanni #Carnevali during his time at #Sassuolo, leaving it as a great testament to his work before he left."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

😬 "Pape Sarr took part in the group training, there is a possibility he could be on the bench on Sunday, but his presence during the match remains a doubt.#Cambiaso is running behind schedule, it would be surprising to see him in the squad list against #Sassuolo.As for #McKennie, significant pessimism is filtering out from la Continassa on his availability for Sunday."[@romeoagresti on the YouTube channel of @ilbianconerocom via @PuebloJ]

👀 "During today's training, Luciano #Spalletti tested #Woltemade and #KoloMuani together.There is still a lot of work to be done for them to be able to play together, but it is something the coach wants to insist on developing.The main problem is that if both start, at this moment, he would have no alternatives on the bench."[@romeoagresti on the YouTube channel of @ilbianconerocom via @PuebloJ]
All the best to Mauricio Isla, who announces his retirement from football. Thanks for everything, Mauricio! 🤍🖤[Juventus]

👀📋 #Spalletti is considering fielding #Woltemade and #KoloMuani together: in a 4-2-3-1, the German could start as an attacking midfielder right behind the Frenchman. Alternatively, a 4-2-4 could further enhance their interchangeability, with more cautious full-backs and central midfielders with fewer forward runs. The coach will test the various solutions to determine whether to deploy them right from the start in Reggio Emilia or during the game.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 #Juventus and #Inter agree on the need to bring in the best young talents, prioritizing a base of Italian players, to build their sporting projects against the superior economic power of foreign clubs.Key mercato objectives:▫️Samuele #Inácio (2008): The Italian-Brazilian forward from #BorussiaDortmund (renewed until 2029) leads the priorities of both clubs.Following an initial inquiry by #Inter, #Juve is gaining ground thanks to the smooth relationship between the management (led by Giovanni #Carnevali) and the player's agent, Edoardo Crnjar.Furthermore, the national team coach Roberto Mancini plans to call him up to the Italian squad soon to secure his international commitment ahead of in

The first bits of good news have emerged from today's #Juventus training session.Pape #Sarr has partially returned to group training 🔙On the other hand, #McKennie and #Cambiaso are continuing with their individualized training programs ⚠️@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

⁉️ #Spalletti would have the intention of starting both #Woltemade and #KoloMuani against #Sassuolo. The German could be used as an attacking midfielder right behind the Frenchman.[SportMediaset via @AroundJuventus]

😅 According to Corriere dello Sport, #Cambiaso continues to recover from a sprained right ankle and worked separately from the group during the latest training session. #Juventus has no intention of rushing his return, therefore he will miss the match against #Sassuolo and his return could take place only after international break. [@AverageJuventinoGuy]

🔄 INJURY UPDATE#McKennie is feeling much better but it is likely he won't be risked against #Sassuolo. #Cambiaso still feels some pain in his ankle, #Sarr is not yet 100% and will, at most, make the bench on Sunday.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @AverageJuventinoGuy]

🔙⁉️ #McKennie will train with the group starting tomorrow and will try to be available against #Sassuolo, but without taking any risks. #Cambiaso is continuously improving and could return to training between today and tomorrow. However, for him as well, no rushing: if he continues to feel even slight pain, he will no be available on Sunday. Also on the waiting list for a return is #Sarr, who has not yet carried out a training session with his teammates.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

Thought of the Day 💭 Locatelli's absence is a blow to an already injury-hit squad, but from a captaincy change perspective, it feels quite undramatic.Bremer is admittedly a different type of leader, not as vocal and judged from the outside much calmer in his way of leading, - but he has worn the armband on several occasions and is an experienced player at the top level.Most importantly is he highly respected by the entire squad, so there should be no reasons for concern in this regard ⚫️⚪️
#Juve, #Sarr's comebackFrom today, the Senegalese training with the group[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

THE DERBY OF YOUNG ITALY#Juve and #Inter, priority on Italians and the mercato battles have already begun.Samuele #Inacio, Pià's son, has emerged on the bianconero list, and he is also drawing interest from the nerazzurri, as well as #Fiorentina's #Ndour. In Dortmund, eyes are also on #Mané, then there are also #Lipani from #Sassuolo and #Palmisani, the #Frosinone goalkeeper. They are all already part of the Italian national teams.[Front Page TuttoSport]
